criteria.requirement: State-changing operations require the construct approval policy.
Filesystem operations remain within the authorized workspace.
Command execution uses the governed job surface and produces an operation record.
Browser state changes follow the approval boundary and are verified.
Durable memory can be retrieved across sessions.
Failures are recorded without automatic lesson promotion.
State-changing work has a verified rollback path.
Material work produces structured evidence and a receipt.
A bounded workflow can coordinate multiple authorized capabilities.
